name: anun333/oe-module-units-check
description: See what an OpenEMR site keeps as units in UCUM terms, the unit codes FHIR, C-CDA, eCQMs and HL7 v2 exchange, and add UCUM codes to its unit list options

footprint-not-covered: Whether the permission check above behaves correctly for a user without `admin / super`. The end-to-end check refuses a clinician; the README's "Who can open what" section describes it.
Whether the units it reports and the UCUM codes it adds are right. The unit tests in `tests/` cover the matching; the end-to-end check against a running OpenEMR is described in the README.
